mapper.sql: SELECT po.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_product op WHERE op.order_id = po.id) AS line_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(op.ordered_cost, 0) * COALESCE(op.ordered_quantity, 0)), 0) FROM order_product op WHERE op.order_id = po.id) AS lines_total_cost, COALESCE(sup.name, from_outlet.name) AS from_name, CASE WHEN po.type = 'RETURN' THEN to_sup.name WHEN po.type = 'CREDIT' AND to_outlet.id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(to_sup.name, tr.name) ELSE COALESCE(to_outlet.name, tr.name) END AS to_name FROM purchase_order po LEFT JOIN supplier sup ON sup.id = po.from_id AND po.type = 'ORDER' LEFT JOIN outlet from_outlet ON from_outlet.id = po.from_id AND po.type IN ('TRANSFER', 'RETURN', 'RECEIVE', 'CREDIT') LEFT JOIN outlet to_outlet ON to_outlet.id = po.to_id AND po.type <> 'RETURN' LEFT JOIN supplier to_sup ON to_sup.id = po.to_id AND po.type IN ('RETURN', 'CREDIT') LEFT JOIN transferee tr ON tr.id = po.to_id AND tr.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: ORDER BY po.created_at DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
